name: screenshot-to-code
setup: . scripts/env.sh && POETRY_CACHE_DIR="$PWD/.tools/poetry-cache" POETRY_VIRTUALENVS_CREATE=false .venv/bin/uv tool run --python 3.12 --from poetry==2.5.1 --with poetry-plugin-export==1.10.1 poetry -C "$SRC/backend" export --with dev --without-hashes -f requirements.txt -o "$(cd "$ENV" && pwd)/poetry-export.txt"
notes: Each setup command that runs uv sources scripts/env.sh itself so caches/Python installs stay in .tools. Baseline measured with cwd=$SRC=eval/work/base/<name> under a clean env (env -i HOME/PATH/LANG + test_env, RAMP_ROUTER_API_KEY unset, no provider API keys) with outbound network denied via macOS sandbox-exec (loopback + unix sockets allowed); counts were identical on a from-scratch rebuild into eval/work/envs/<name>-check (since deleted). No CI workflow exists; command follows root package.json test:backend / AGENTS.md (`cd backend && poetry run pytest`; backend/pytest.ini sets testpaths=tests, asyncio_mode=auto). Deps come from backend/poetry.lock: poetry 2.5.1 + poetry-plugin-export 1.10.1 run ephemerally via `uv tool run` (cached in .tools/uv-tools/.tools/uv-cache, poetry cache in .tools/poetry-cache) export main+dev groups to $ENV/poetry-export.txt (fully pinned), installed with uv pip; no poetry venv is created and $SRC is not modified. Python 3.12 (pyproject ^3.10; Dockerfile uses 3.12.3). No deselections and no skips; all LLM clients are hand-rolled fakes. If a migration changes backend/pyproject.toml deps without updating poetry.lock, the export step will fail (poetry refuses a stale lock) - run `poetry lock` in that case. Tests write gitignored backend/evals_data/.
